title: A proposed role requires exclusion from incompatible slots
summary: For any candidate role that claims a concrete function such as quantity carrier, nominal item, or process operator, test its required negative context: the same complete whole should be rare or absent in a preregistered incompatible slot after matching section, position, and neighboring frame. This is a counterexample screen, not a positive classifier.

design.mechanism: A concrete role imposes a semantic incompatibility boundary, so an item-like whole cannot freely occupy a process-only slot (and conversely).
design.unit: complete-whole occurrence paired with a predeclared compatible/incompatible structural slot
design.contrast: candidate whole's incompatible-slot rate versus matched control wholes with the same frequency, section, and position profile
design.prediction: At least one independently held candidate role shows a low incompatible-slot rate with a fixed upper bound, while matched opaque controls do not; a positive association without exclusion is insufficient.
design.scope: cached exact-whole occurrence panels and existing structural tags; feasibility unknown until compatible/incompatible slots are frozen without using the target outcomes
design.falsifier: Repeated held-folio counterexamples in the preregistered incompatible slot, or no separation from frequency/position controls, rejects the role claim and leaves the whole opaque.
design.related: GDT770 target-masked valency tournament; GDT805 context-role discriminator; GDT762 role candidates; this proposal adds a negative necessary-condition gate rather than another role fit
